part1.desc: Verifies that all impls: - Live in a `t` commons module (see import-rules check); and - Are in the same file or a sibling file of the type's definition.
part1.exceptions: - For foreign types (i.e. not defined in our crate; like: `impl SomeTrait for Vec<T>`), the impl must live in an `ext_traits` commons module. - For private types, impls in the same file as the type definition are allowed.
part1.rationale: To have an expected locations for impls, and part of the effort to encourage small impls, preferring free-functions over methods.

part2.desc: Verifies that nothing inside a `t` module calls a free-function from our crate.
part2.exceptions: - The free function is in the same `t` module - We don't own the free function (e.g. it's from a dependency or std)
part2.rationale: To encourage small impls, preferring free-functions over methods
